0022600029.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (6-2, 5th in the West) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-2, 4th in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, with both teams on 6-2 over their last ten and the Thunder riding a two-game win streak while Memphis has lost two straight. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams, Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber, while Memphis is missing Scotty Pippen Jr. and has Isaiah Stewart listed as day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-0, including a 117-116 road win in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
